title: Analysis-ready satellite data mosaics from Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery
author: Ørka, Gailis, et al.

steps.title: Prepare Input Satellite Data
steps.instruction: Gather surface reflectance data for the target area using one of the following supported types: Sentinel-2 (L2A), Landsat 8 Collection 1 (LaSRC - OLI/TIRS), or Landsat 4-7 Collection 1 (LEDAPS - TM/ETM+).

steps.title: Perform Spatiotemporal Data Aggregation
steps.instruction: Process the input scenes sequentially to build the mosaic using the following preprocessing sequence:

substeps.instruction: Sort all input scenes by date.
Reproject scenes to the desired target projection if necessary.
Calculate the spatial extents of potential contributions from each scene.
Generate a pixel selection mask for each step using the Geomosaic method.

steps.title: Calculate Class Scores
steps.instruction: Assign a class score to each pixel based on the satellite-specific hierarchy to determine quality (higher score equals better quality).

substeps.instruction: For Sentinel-2, use the hierarchy: 1 (no_data, saturated, defective), 2 (cloud_medium/high probability), 3 (thin cirrus), 4 (snow/ice), 5 (Dark, shadow, unclassified), 6 (vegetation, soil, water), 7 (clear_terrain, water).

For Landsat, use the hierarchy: 1 (no_data, saturated), 2 (terrain_occlusion), 3 (cloud_medium/high probability), 4 (cirrus_medium/high probability), 5 (snow/ice), 6 (dark, shadow), 7 (clear_terrain, water).

steps.title: Calculate Pixel Desirability Score
steps.instruction: Compute the weighted desirability score (Sdes) for each scene using the formula: Sdes = wdate*Sdate + wgpix*Sgpix + waot*Saot, where weights (wdate, wgpix, waot) are between 0 and 1 and sum to 1.

substeps.instruction: Calculate Sdate (relative distance from target date) using Sdate = exp(-(Dtarget - D)^2 / (2 * σ^2)), where σ = 30 days.
Calculate Sgpix (ratio of good pixels) as the sum of pixels with the highest possible class score (6 for Sentinel-2, 7 for Landsat) divided by the total number of pixels (n).
Calculate Saot (mean aerosol optical thickness) as: Saot = 1 - (sum of aoti / n), where aoti is the aerosol optical thickness of pixel i.

steps.title: Update Mosaic Pixels
steps.instruction: Update the mosaic pixels based on the class and desirability scores of the new scene compared to the current mosaic.

substeps.instruction: Replace the mosaic pixel if the new scene's pixel has a larger class score.
If the class scores are equal, replace the mosaic pixel only if the new scene's desirability score (Sdes) is higher than the current pixel's Sdes.
Update all bands in the mosaic for the selected pixels.

steps.title: Generate Metadata Tilemap
steps.instruction: Create a tilemap containing a metadata identifier (stored as an unsigned integer) for each pixel to trace it back to the original input scene, and export this as a GeoTiff file.
